blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Monumental stepwells, cenotes, public fountains, village wells, observatory wells, and civic water gauges where practical maintenance and communal ritual naturally meet.
World relation: Crafted World infrastructure, Continuity World ritual memory, and Open World shared access.
Connection to newer locations: It connects to the Monsoon Stepwell City, Sunken Terraces of Eris, Salt Mirror Archive, Wet Memory Marsh, and City of Rainward Roofs.

Abstract or metaphorical relation: A technical interface becomes sacred when generations depend on it and no longer possess its original vocabulary. Ritual can preserve useful care without proving that a conscious god lives inside the mechanism.
